items: 【Reasonable Size】Each plant support garden stake is 16 inch height, 10 inch width, the diameter of wire is 1/5 inch, package total 6 pcs garden plant stakes, half round for easy to install and use.

【Sturdy and Durable】The half round peony cages and supports are made of sturdy iron with dark green plastic coating, light weight,stand firmly, hard to deform,weather-resistant, rust-proof, not easy to fade, durable and reusable, well support and protect the garden plants.

【Widely Applications】Our plant support rings are suitable for supporting most bushy plants like hydrangeas, tomato plants, roses, peonies, salvias, and vine plants like cherry tomato, pumpkin, cucumber, melon etc.

【Useful Functions】The plant supports for outdoor plants are sturdy enough to support garden plants to grow uprightly and healthily, prevent vine from spreading out, protect plants against strong wind, heavy rain or their own heavy blooms, create well ordered border and keep pathways open.The dark green colored stakes allows for natural blend of stem plants for seamless look.

【About Us】FEED GARDEN provides quality products and efficient after-sales service.If you're not satisfied with our plant support garden stakes,please contact us, we will provide you with a solution as soon as possible.
